$comment: Course spine for Build Your First AI Agent. Source file: fixtures/scripts/build-ai-agent.mjs fills each lesson's notes from its video and each module's minutes from its content, then writes fixtures/courses.json.
title: Build Your First AI Agent
tagline: Orbit Outdoor's support team is drowning: 400 tickets a day, most of them "where is my order?". Their FAQ chatbot can talk, but it can't look anything up. Over six modules you build Scout, an AI agent that reads the question, calls the right tools, remembers the conversation and knows when to hand over to a person.
goal: Design, build, test and deploy a working AI agent in Python: a language model that plans, calls tools, uses memory and stays inside safe limits.
learn: Explain what makes an agent different from a chatbot or a fixed workflow, and when each one is the right tool.
Call a language model from Python with a clear system prompt and get back structured JSON you can trust.
Give an agent tools, let it decide when to use them, and handle the errors real APIs throw.
Add memory, retrieval and a think-act-observe loop, then test, evaluate, guard and deploy the agent you built.
